notes.title: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're currently developing a new game to the Choppa franchise called Choppa: Rescue Rivals!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173100/Choppa_Rescue_Rivals/]Choppa: Rescue Rivals [/url]  is a chaotic arcade-style helicopter rescue competition game where you compete in extreme rescue matches against casual or competitive online opponents and locally with friends. 

We'd hope you check out the new game and join our beta test periods in the future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173100/Choppa_Rescue_Rivals/

notes.title: Ending MacOS support
notes.notes:
Hi pilots, sad news time.

We have made the difficult decision of ending support for the macOS version of Choppa in light of recent notarization and 64-bit requirement changes Apple made to their platform. Since the sales of this game on Steam have never been that great, we're unable to provide high quality support for the tiny percentage of people purchasing the game on for Apple computers.

So with a heavy heart we are halting sales of the macOS version, effective immediately. If you've purchased the game before for Mac, you should be able to re-download the game like always and use all Steam features, provided that you are not running the latest macOS version that requires a 64-bit, notarized binary. New purchases on Mac cannot be made anymore.

We are sorry for the inconvenience and hope you will continue enjoying playing Choppa on Windows. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: New choppas and full controller support update
notes.notes:
Surprise pilots!

To celebrate another discount, here's a new update for you to enjoy. With it you will get two new choppas to unlock and a bunch of bug fixes. The new Vacuum and Winch choppas will ensure physics-based mayhem with their unique abilities, go check them out!

We're also adding full controller support so you no longer will be forced to navigate the launcher with a mouse to enjoy some people rescuing action. Time to bring the salvation action to the big screen.

We have been pretty busy here at Parta Games and will have some Choppa related news to share with you all very soon!

Fly high and GET TO THE CHOPPA!

notes.title: Finland 100-year anniversary update!
notes.notes:
We released an update in commemoration of our homecountry Finland turning 100-years old on 2017-12-06!

- Added a new AK-84 Chopper variation with glorious Finnish flag colors!
- Tweaked Santa's Sleigh to make it easier to maneuver in tight spots and preventing it getting stuck
- Added a volume slider to settings
- Fixed problems that prevented "Look How Shiny it is!" and "Dancing in Dough" achievements from triggering
- Other small fixes

Thanks for playing and GET TO THE CHOPPA!

notes.title: Small post-launch update
notes.notes:
We released a small post-launch update that fixes the following problems:

- Fixed discrepancies between local and steam leaderboard scores (time in SURVIVAL mode)
- Fixed a problem where OIL RIG & DESERT leaderboard scores were incorrectly sent to Steam leaderboards
- Fixed problem that prevented "Ugh!" achievement from triggering

Thanks for playing and GET TO THE CHOPPA!
